Rows include priority, deadline, readiness, ready_at, ready_by, concluded_on, last_response and unresolved/blocking requirement counts; full requirements are on the attempt read. no_reply gives the period in days, its source (the policy's No reply decision item, confirmed or not, or the 30-day default) and the number of Applied applications past it (due).

readiness is derived from current revision leaves and unresolved blocking requirements; ready is reported only for an application marked ready (ready_at, ready_by) whose checks still pass. pinned_note is the application's pinned note; note, its text, is deprecated since 0.22 and removed in 0.23.

operations.dashboard: Jobs: Start application (the selected job or a Shortlist row)

Starting retains saved interest and leaves the pending Shortlist queue; it never submits or generates documents. Optional priority (1 highest to 5), deadline (YYYY-MM-DD) and structured employer requirements. note is deprecated since 0.22 (removed in 0.23): non-empty, it creates the application's pinned note.

operations.dashboard: Applications: progress, planning, requirements and questions/answers
operations.notes: expected_version prevents lost updates; recorded state changes create lifecycle history. Entering Closed requires an explicit outcome: accepted, rejected, not_pursued or no_response (no answer within the no-reply period; only for a sent application, with concluded_on, today by default). Moving to Interview or Offer, or closing as rejected (or accepted without an offer on record) records the matching employer response, dated response_date (today by default) with response_note; a response of that kind on that day is never repeated, and its date stays correctable with responses.update. Reopening enforces one open attempt per job. applied_at, priority or deadline null clears the value. requirements replaces the whole list; keep existing ids. The returned job is the compact job summary. Leaving Preparing or adding/unresolving a blocking requirement clears the stored Ready step. note is deprecated since 0.22 (removed in 0.23): it edits the pinned note, adds it pinned when there is none, or unpins it when empty, without changing the application version.

Cleared automatically, with an attributed application_ready_cleared event and its reason, by a new revision or context, a deleted revision, a file added to a current revision, a blocking requirement, or leaving Preparing. Never submits anything.
